newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso dips in slow month-end trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso dips in slow month-end trade.

text.p: Colombia's peso dipped 1.2 pesos to 1,113 against the dollar in a quiet month-end session, interbank traders said.
Dealers said banks with excess peso liquidity were snapping up greenbacks to push the dollar rate higher for the end of the month and that there was also some demand from vehicle assemblers.
Petro-dollars, exports earnings from coal and dollar- denominated foreign debt, supplied the market, dealers said.
Dealers reported 162 trades worth just $87 million, about half the daily average. The peso opened at 1,111.5 and traded between an intraday low of 1,110 and a high of 1,115.1.
